payloadSchema.title: brain.assertion@1
payloadSchema.description: One typed semantic claim between two artifacts. The knowledge graph the UI draws is a projection over accepted assertions — there is no mutable edge table.

notes: UI: the link node ('Wikilinks in beide Richtungen — das Netz wächst'), '12 Artefakte im Brain', '[[Umzug 2025]] · 9 Verknüpfungen', 'Backlinks · 3'.
Both endpoints are also declared run inputs. The ids in the payload make the claim self-contained; the run inputs make it authorizable and traversable.
same-as must never be inferred from a duplicate check. It needs its own assertion, normally after a review.decision@1.
Retraction publishes a new assertion with predicate 'supersedes' pointing at the old one; assertions are never edited or deleted.
